public_rationale: The deadline has passed, but the evidence does not settle the proposition under Marcus's unspecified original definitions. The podcast forecast was narrower and more qualified than his description suggests. Strong pre-deadline benchmark results document progress, but do not establish broad AGI. Conversely, failure to find an accepted AGI demonstration does not establish that none existed or that its arrival was implausible.
limitations: The probability language cannot be calibrated from this single outcome.
Benchmark evidence covers only part of the claimed capability.
The source does not identify a definitive historical AGI standard.
